Dear Sir/Madam,  
 
Subject: Schedule of Q2 - 2026-27 Analyst/ Investor Con-call 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Para A of Part A of Schedule III of the Securities and Exchange 
Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (“Listing 
Regulations”), we herewith enclose the invitation of Q2 - 2026-27 earnings conference meet for the 
analysts/investors, scheduled to be held on Friday, November 6, 2026, at 04:00 PM (IST) through 
Microsoft Teams Meeting.  
 
Please note that the schedule shall be subject to changes, if any. No Unpublished Price Sensitive 
Information is intended to be discussed during the meeting. 
 
As prescribed under the Listing Regulations, the presentations, recordings and transcript of the 
aforesaid meet will be uploaded on the Company’s website and will be intimated to the Stock 
Exchanges in due course.  
 
The above intimation is also being hosted on the website of the Company at www.elgi.com.  
 
We request to kindly take the above intimation on records.   
 
Thanking you, 
 
Yours faithfully 
FOR ELGI EQUIPMENTS LIMITED 
 
ROHIT GUPTE
